column1: # openbsd/packages.tsv — the packages the box installs.
# Columns: package, the scripts that install it (comma separated), and whether
# the CI OpenBSD VM installs it. The deploy scripts read this table through
# need_packages in lib.sh; scripts/install-packages.sh installs the rows for CI,
# or the whole table on the box.
# `box` is the checkout itself: git updates it, and no deploy owns that. The CI
# column is not "the box has it", it is "the self-test VM needs it", so rust and
# dovecot stay out even though the mail deploy installs them: the self-tests do
# not build the plugin or start the mail daemons.
# curl and jq are the clients the onboarding and keyring scripts use. jq is also
# the only base64 encoder on the box: OpenBSD ships no base64(1).
# gmid provides the Gemini server and the _gmid account the capsule sockets use.
curl
dovecot
git
gmid
gnupg
hcloud
helix
jq
opensmtpd-filter-dkimsign
restic
rust
